title: Dissector-side defects in consumers of Wireshark's wmem pools: thirteen temporal, five spatial
note: Cases 0-12 are temporal; cases 13-17 are SPATIAL, from the hunt recorded in docs/ref/wireshark-spatial-defect-triage.md. Cases 14 and 15 are the corpus's only rows LIVE at the v4.6.8 pin -- every other row, temporal and spatial alike, is a fix-reversal. Note for anyone reading the spatial rows: every arm of this harness narrows a wmem allocation to its request (wm_narrow(), ports/wireshark/wmem/src/shared/wmem-port-hooks.h:11-15), so a spatial crossing faults on ALL arms and these rows do not discriminate the chunk port. Case 13's run established that by refuting its own prediction.
